core.name: Normal Move
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

core.name: Run
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

core.name: Retreat
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
core.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit's combat range.

core.name: Shoot
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
core.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

core.name: Charge
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
core.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

core.name: Fight
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit's attacks (see 16.0).
core.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

core.name: Ward Save
core.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

core.name: Guarded Hero
core.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit's attacks (see 16.0).
core.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

commands.name: Rally
commands.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
effect: Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:

list: For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.

effect: You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.
